In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the redhead woman (R1) stands on the left wearing a light blue shirt over a brown top and beige skirt, with her right hand resting on her collarbone and her gaze directed downwards with a soft, thoughtful expression. Standing back-to-back and leaning slightly against her, the dark-haired woman (R2) on the right wears a white wrap blouse, with her left hand resting on her shoulder as she looks directly at the camera with a calm, serious expression. The composition is illuminated by soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a neutral, warm color palette.
